description:
Programme Overview

The NYCU International Student Scholarship (formerly NCTU) at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University offers monthly stipends and tuition awards for international students. The 30 September 2026 deadline is for Spring 2027 semester graduate programs only. Classes begin 15 February 2027.

Important Name Correction

National Chiao Tung University (NCTU) merged with National Yang-Ming University on 1 February 2021 to form National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU). All applications must use NYCU.

Financial Coverage

  • Monthly stipend ranges: Undergraduate NT$5,000-21,000; Master's NT$7,000-25,000; PhD NT$15,000-30,000.
  • Tuition award: Either full waiver of tuition and credit fees OR local-student rate reduction. Decided by committee based on budget.
  • Elite PhD Scholarship: NT$33,000/month (NT$25,000 OIA + NT$8,000 advisor matching) plus full tuition waiver. First 2 years. Approximately 1 awardee per college. Renewal GPA 3.76+.
  • Duration: 1 year at a time. Renewable up to 4 years (UG), 2 years (Master's), 5 years (PhD) if GPA maintained.

Eligibility Criteria

  • International students excluding Taiwan nationals.
  • Cannot hold Taiwan government scholarships concurrently.
  • Must obtain Alien Residence Certificate.
  • Must take Mandarin courses (4 for UG, 2 for MS/PhD).
  • English proficiency at CEFR B1+ (IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 73, TOEIC 750 recommended minima; waivers per department).
  • Award terminates if leaving Taiwan more than 30 days for non-academic reasons.

Key Dates (Spring 2027 Intake)

MilestoneDate
Applications open10 August 2026
Application deadline30 September 2026, 11:59 AM GMT+8
Results13 November 2026
Reply by22 November 2026
Classes begin15 February 2027

Application Process

  1. Create account in NYCU online admission system during window.
  2. Upload transcripts, degree certificate, passport, study plan, recommendation letters, financial proof, and English proficiency proof.
  3. Mark Apply for NYCU Scholarship in the application's scholarship section.
  4. Pay NT$2,000 department application fee.
  5. Departments review, Committee confirms stipend and tuition award.
  6. After enrolment: maintain GPA (3.0 UG / 3.5 graduate), submit transcripts and tuition receipts each semester.

Cost Context

Estimated international-student basic tuition: approximately NT$25,960/semester on Chiao Tung side. Graduate credit fees higher on Yangming campus (NT$51,280-78,340/semester).

Official Links

  • OIA Scholarships hub: https://oia.nycu.edu.tw
  • Apply Now: https://oia.nycu.edu.tw
  • Study in Taiwan: https://www.studyintaiwan.org

Important Notes

  • Fully funded is possible but not guaranteed. Committee may grant local-student fee rate instead of full waiver.
  • Stipend figures are ranges, not fixed amounts.
  • Bachelor's applicants must use Fall round (March 15 deadline). September 30 is graduate-only.
  • NYCU has not outsourced admissions to any agency.
